012public interface SwerveConstants {
013    public interface Characterization {
014        Time FF_START_DELAY = Seconds.of(1);

016
017        AngularVelocity WHEEL_RADIUS_MAX_VELOCITY = RadiansPerSecond.of(0.25);
018        AngularAcceleration WHEEL_RADIUS_RAMP_RATE = RadiansPerSecondPerSecond.of(0.05);

021    public interface SwerveCharacterization {

029
030        public interface DriveSysId {

034            Time DYNAMIC_TIMEOUT = Seconds.of(2);
035        }
036
037        public interface SteerSysId {
038            Velocity<VoltageUnit> RAMP_RATE = Volts.of(1).per(Second);
039            Voltage STEP_VOLTAGE = Volts.of(7);

041            Time DYNAMIC_TIMEOUT = Seconds.of(2);
